THE YAMANI METHOD

Health is usually handled in pieces: one appointment for this, one specialist for that. Dr. Yamani’s approach brings those separate pieces together into a single, physician-led method for living a healthier, more capable life for longer.

A repeatable way of helping people know what is happening with their health, and what to do next.

  • NutritionNourish for life
  • MovementStrength for today and tomorrow
  • ConnectionPeople matter
  • StressA calmer, stronger you

Physician-led. Always.

The rest is best explained over lunch.

DR. M.I. YAMANI

Board-certified Internal Medicine physician

Dr. Yamani has spent his career in the practice of internal medicine, and lifestyle medicine is part of how he cares for patients every day.

  • Certified practitioner, Dr. Dean Ornish Lifestyle Medicine Program
  • Master’s in Medical Management, Carnegie Mellon University
  • Master’s in Clinical Service Operations, Harvard Medical School
